usage: The word '家庭' refers to a family or household, including people living together.
It is commonly used to talk about family members or family life.
'家庭' can be used to describe both immediate and extended family units.
It often appears in conversations about responsibilities or relationships within a family.
You can use '家庭' to emphasize the collective aspect of family rather than individual members.
